residual_limits: No public vehicle ID register, so the 25 BEB ages are inferred only from the two 2014 and twenty-three 2022 purchases.
No route block, depot, charger or firm-power data are used in this Chicago certificate.
The conclusion is against the current published FMP envelope and 2024 ramp; a larger procurement plan can change it.

london.source: TfL Bus Fleet Audit, 31 March 2023, detailed registration/body tables
london.plan_interpretation: One like-body electric bus replaces each non-electric fleet slot; existing electric slots due under the selected life cap are renewed. This is an order-batch plan at body-class level, not a route or garage plan.
residual_limits: Route-to-vehicle assignments and the required spare fleet are not in the audit.
Depot charging capacity, site power, delivery lead times and local prices are absent.
Life caps are sensitivity scenarios, not asserted TfL retirement rules.
The 2024 catch-up must be paired with facility-ready garages before it is operationally executable.

shared_boundary: These certificates establish vehicle-body and age stock flows only. They do not establish route-level service preservation or charging feasibility.
